title: The Adventures Of The X-Men #6 Marvel Comics September 1996 - Direct Edition
descriptionText: The Adventures of the X-Men #6 Marvel Comics September 1996 is a collectible comic book featuring the popular superhero team, the X-Men. This particular issue, part of the Modern Age era, showcases the adventures of the X-Men in the genre of superheroes. Published by Marvel Comics, this direct edition is a sought-after item for fans and collectors alike, highlighting the dynamic and diverse characters within the X-Men universe.
